name: Desert
author: Hans Fugal <hans@fugal.net>
description: Standalone, multi-application color theme extracted from Hans Fugal's classic Vim Desert color scheme. Characterized by warm earth tones, soft charcoal backgrounds, khaki keywords, sky blue comments, and pale green identifiers.

grey30.role: Secondary surface background, folds, gutters, inactive panels

grey40.role: Elevated surfaces, menus, cursorline, concealed items

grey50.role: Borders, split separators, inactive statusline text

black.role: Inverted contrast text on light accents (e.g. status bar)

desertTan.role: Statusline background, split borders, tabline fill

khaki.role: Keywords/Statements, cursor background, active highlights, search focus

indianRed.role: Preprocessor directives, imports, headings, warnings, errors

lightSalmon.role: Constants, numeric literals, strings, boolean values

navajoWhite.role: Special characters, escape sequences, delimiters, regex

gold.role: Line numbers, fold indicators, active line badges

canvas.description: Primary application/window background (classic Vim grey20). Muted charcoal that prevents eye strain compared to harsh pitch black.

surface.description: Secondary level surface for sidebars, fold bars, gutter panels, and inactive tabs (grey30).

elevated.description: Floating elements such as dropdowns, context menus, autocomplete menus, and active line bands (grey40).

selection.description: Visual text selection background (olivedrab). Organic muted olive earth tone providing strong contrast without blinding glare.

searchMatch.description: General search highlight background (peru). Warm earthy copper tone.

searchFocused.description: Active/current search match and cursor position background (khaki).

statusBar.description: Desert tan (#c2bfa5) for active status line; dark grey (#4d4d4d) for inactive windows.

border.description: Muted grey (#7f7f7f) or desert tan (#c2bfa5) for window splits and component borders.

primary.description: Crisp white body text (guifg=White) with maximum legibility against #333333 canvas.

muted.description: SkyBlue (#87ceeb) for comments, documentation, and explanatory text. Soft, easily readable yet clearly secondary.

subtle.description: Mid-grey (#7f7f7f) for line numbers, inactive window titles, and decorative borders.

accent.description: Warm khaki (#f0e68c) for selected text, active prompts, and focused items.

inverse.description: Black text (#000000) placed over light surfaces such as the active desert-tan status bar or khaki menus.

heading.description: IndianRed (#cd5c5c) for headers, titles, section banners, and command output summaries.

link.description: Underlined light blue (#75a0ff) for hyperlinks, file paths, and external references.

warning.description: IndianRed (#cd5c5c) for warnings and caution labels.

error.description: Bright red (#ff0000) for fatal errors, parse failures, and diagnostics.

success.description: Pale green (#98fb98) for success confirmations, passing tests, and prompt markers.

keyword.description: Khaki. Language keywords, control flow statements (if, else, return, for, while, switch, def, class).

type.description: DarkKhaki. Type definitions, built-in types, classes, structs, traits, interfaces (int, string, bool, void, Promise).

identifier.description: PaleGreen. Variable names, object keys, declared function and method names.

constant.description: LightSalmon (#ffa0a0). String literals, numbers, booleans, constants, and enum members.

preprocessor.description: IndianRed. Import statements, preprocessor directives, macros, decorators, annotations (#include, import, export).

special.description: NavajoWhite. Escape sequences (\n, \t), special operators, regex literals, punctuation delimiters.

comment.description: SkyBlue. Single-line comments, multi-line blocks, docstrings, annotations.

specialKey.description: YellowGreen. Hidden whitespace, tab characters, non-printable characters.

todo.description: Bright red on yellow. High-visibility TODO, FIXME, BUG markers.
